description: This file defines the IStateMachineManager interface, which manages state machines for a grain in Orleans. It includes methods for initialization, registration, retrieval, state writing, and deletion.

classes.name: IStateMachineManager
classes.description: Interface for managing state machines within Orleans grains, including registration, initialization, and state persistence operations.

methods.name: InitializeAsync
methods.description: Initializes the state machine manager asynchronously.

methods.name: RegisterStateMachine
methods.description: Registers a state machine with the manager.

methods.name: TryGetStateMachine
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve a registered state machine by name.

methods.name: WriteStateAsync
methods.description: Persists the current state to storage asynchronously.
